ABOUT

ABOUT B2 BUILD LTD

YOUR VISION, OUR MISSION.

B2 Build Ltd is a Calgary-based custom home builder specializing in luxury inner-city residences. Founded on the principle that every home should be a masterwork of craft and design, we bring decades of construction expertise to each and every project.

From initial concept to final walkthrough, our team works closely with homeowners to understand their vision, lifestyle, and aspirations. We believe building a home should be an exciting journey — one marked by transparent communication, meticulous attention to detail, and a shared passion for creating spaces that truly elevate everyday living.

Our portfolio spans the full spectrum of inner-city living — from custom infill homes in established neighbourhoods to complete whole-home renovations that reimagine space in bold new ways. Every project reflects our unwavering commitment to quality craftsmanship and modern design principles.

We build in Calgary's most desirable communities: Altadore, Killarney, Mount Pleasant, Marda Loop, and beyond. Our clients choose us because they want more than a house — they want a home that tells their story.
